safety_analysis.what_is_the_risk:
• Workers operating at height without fall protection.
• Missing perimeter guardrails and safety netting.
• Workers standing on narrow temporary planks.
• Imminent risk of serious or fatal fall.
safety_analysis.how_to_improve:
• Halt all elevated work immediately.
• Require 100% tie-off using full-body safety harnesses.
• Erect certified top-rails, mid-rails, and toe-boards.
• Inspect scaffolding planks before resuming work.
safety_analysis.summary: Fall hazard at height. Safety harnesses and guardrails are needed immediately.
